SECTION D: Long Answer Type Questions (5 Marks Each)

Q32. (a) Describe the necessity of political parties in a democratic country.  
OR  
(b) Describe the various challenges faced by political parties in India.

Answer / Solution:
(a) Describe the necessity of political parties in a democratic country. 
Formation of Govt: They contest elections and run the government. 
Law Making: They play a decisive role in legislation. 
Opposition: They criticize government failures. 
Public Opinion: They shape public opinion on issues. 
OR (b) Describe the various challenges faced by political parties in India. 
Lack of Internal Democracy: Power concentrated in top leaders. 
Dynastic Succession: Top positions controlled by one family. 
Money & Muscle Power: Use of unfair means to win elections. 
Lack of Choice: Ideological differences between parties are narrowing.
